name: FiatDock
description: Non-custodial USDC on/off-ramp API for AI agents. Agents pay $0.05 USDC per call via x402 to create bank cash-out (SELL) or top-up (BUY) sessions; quotes and order tracking are free. Conversion, KYC and custody by Transak (licensed provider). Also exposed as MCP tools (remote + npm).
